read: You can easily enjoy pav bhaji tonight by making a Jain version with raw banana, keeping the butter sensible and adding protein.

plates.name: Jain pav bhaji with paneer
items: 2 piece pav toasted with light butter
1.5 katori Jain bhaji made with raw banana, peas and tomato
0.5 katori crumbled fresh paneer stirred in
1 glass plain chaas with roasted jeera
plates.why: Raw banana replaces potato completely, while paneer brings balanced protein to keep your dinner filling and satisfying.
plates.skip: extra melting butter float on the bhaji

plates.name: Spiced Jain tava bhaji with phulka
items: 1.5 katori Jain cauliflower and capsicum bhaji
plates.why: Gives you the same pav bhaji spices in a lighter dinner format that rests easy before bedtime.
